svg.title: The signed error is a difference of two omitted nonnegative components
svg.desc: The omitted informative mean component has a supported population average between zero and U, where U is the average of the logarithmic remainder at source-query mass a. The omitted misinformative component is between zero and L, where L is the average of the remainder at joint-query mass q minus the remainder at target mass v. Their signed difference e equals the population atom minus the finite block expectation, so minus L is at most e and e is at most U. The absolute error is at most the maximum of U and L, which is at most the average remainder at q. This is a symbolic interval, not to scale and not a confidence interval.
svg.text: FINITE CATEGORICAL MGW · MEAN TRUNCATION ERROR
Subtract the omitted components before bounding
Both omitted components are nonnegative. Their difference can have either sign.
eₕ = θ − E[Bₕ] = Eₚ⁺[π⁺ − Pₕ] − Eₚ⁺[π⁻ − Nₕ]
Symbolic interval: −Lₕ ≤ eₕ ≤ Uₕ. Not to scale.
Population expectation bound; not a band around an observed block statistic.
